verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of self-hosting the full Elastic Observability stack in production, no reference architecture, and no upgrade path. The only related items are running Elastic Agent in a container, managing agents with Fleet, and a general 'open source' claim. Those cover collection-side deployment or adjacent positioning, not the stack itself, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can run the full observability stack self-hosted in production with documented architecture and upgrade path
